title: Matt Webb is bunkering down, bracing for more LLM-driven...
content: Matt Webb is bunkering down, bracing for more LLM-driven security exploits. “Realistically, let’s say the internet gets infested with AI worms and we need to turn it off and on again, could we do it?” I had not heard of the air-gapped LLM communication 😳
author: Jason Kottke
